items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I knew Charlie and his wife well... We was friends. We weren't no jealous one or jealous bunch nowhere

ctx.x: Charlie? Oh, yeah. Charlie. I knew Charlie and his wife well. Charlie used to come out and we used to see each other. We used to jam together. I used to go and see him when he was with Tommy Dorsey a lot. Charlie was a good man. "Undecided." That was his big number.
All the guys. We was friends. We weren't no jealous one or jealous bunch nowhere none of them had one in himself that I knew of. I don't think (inaudible) you know?
